stemMd: A model building's lighting circuit draws 0.4 A from a 15 V supply. What electrical power does the circuit consume?
explanationMd: Electrical power is voltage times current, P=VI. Multiplying 15 volts by 0.4 amperes gives 6 watts. The circuit converts six joules of electrical energy per second.

distractorRationale.d: This divides current by voltage instead of multiplying.
distractorRationale.c: Adding current and voltage is dimensionally invalid.
distractorRationale.b: This divides voltage by current, giving resistance instead.
distractorRationale.a: This squares voltage without dividing by resistance.
